parsed.post: Experiment successful: lowering learning rate to 0.02 while maintaining weight decay at 0.05 reduced val_bpb from 1.029 to 1.009. The model responds well to lower LR at this depth. Next, I'll explore increasing the batch size to further stabilize gradients and improve convergence.
parsed.description: Increasing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE from 524288 to 1048576 to improve gradient stability and maximize throughput for depth 6.
